summary: Net security posture is strong and deliberately bounded. The elevation-trust class (recurred ~8x under review) is CLOSED for every state-changing path: doctor --fix short-circuits all auto-remediation when elevated (2.4); forge.cmd bootstrap refuses winget under a positive Medium-integrity-SID probe that FAILS CLOSED on any indeterminate result (2.5); user-scope installs pin --source winget with --exact; no harness RunAs (0040); no user-global config writes. The orchestrated elevation batch is deferred (D-0021) rather than shipped unproven.

Bootstrap winget alias / probe binaries resolved via user-writable dir or %SystemRoot% env — same-context unelevated, guarded elevated; deferred D-0022/D-0023 for real-Windows validation.
